fixed_interval.statement: For I_delta=[2-delta,2], local coefficients <=(1+delta^(-1/2))*N^3*exp(N*omega(delta)), omega(delta)=sqrt(delta)*(2+log(1+2/sqrt(delta))) ->0. Original Hermite filling derivatives retained. Fixed-corner suppression only.

mixed_regions.statement: For k restricted coordinates and r-k unrestricted, exponent <= k*omega(delta)+(r-k)*log(4*(1+sqrt(2))). This suppresses specified original filling terms whenever that exponent is below the filled geometric action. Fewer-than-k positive-end coordinates remain open.

excursions.statement: Opposite-offset bipyramid, even equator m>=6: (QLQ)^(3m)=0 at original targets, independent of N and spectra. Exact signed Schur coefficient and incidence clocks. Shifted targets need u<=2d and cannot inherit the original capacity proof. No norm bound.

representation_gap.statement: For one fixed complete cusped hyperbolic X, boundary-parabolic representation volumes form a finite set; rigidity gives a strict gap off geometric/conjugate classes. Established literature fact, with explicit proof and coverage. Applies to established regular FULL source critical points, not constrained sectors or singular/tail currents.

half_charge.statement: Exact omitted-half spectral factors shift integer Fourier charges by +/-1/2 while preserving original prefactors, parity, cutoff and regularization. No identification with original primitive filling solely by logarithm branch choice.

critical_path: Published general-Morse geometric contribution and its actual filled knot-complement volume identification remain established within their stated scope; do not reopen them as missing.
New estimates suppress a fixed positive-end corner and certain mixed regions of the original filling sum; they do not control the remaining spectral tuples.

For even bipyramids the remaining signed source has an exact finite excursion formula. Prove quantitative bounds for the coupled excursion and good-state factors at a strict geometric gap. Nilpotence alone gives no size estimate.

A direct filled-period alternative may use the boundary-parabolic representation-volume gap, but constrained sectors, half-charge factors, original cycles, singular strata and escaping tails need their actual source proofs.
No new full-invariant volume theorem is claimed. The broader goal remains active and incomplete.
